description: This file declares exported API functions for the HTTP Ato Method object, providing creation, removal, and initialization prototypes relevant to that component in a C environment. It serves as an interface header for implementing or using the Http Ato Method object.

methods.name: HttpCreateAtoMethod
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Http Ato Method object using provided context handles.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodCreate
methods.description: Instantiates the Http Ato Method object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodRemove
methods.description: Removes the Http Ato Method object instance.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects or dependencies for the Http Ato Method instance.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Http Ato Method object instance.
